subject: physics
content:
If minimum possible work is done by a refrigerator in converting 100 grams of water at 0<sup>o</sup>C to ice,
how much heat (in calories) is released to the surroundings at temperature 27<sup>o</sup>C (Latent heat of
ice = 80 Cal/gram) to the nearest integer ?
